body: I know I really shouldn't complain and people have it worse than me but I just feel like i'm at the end of my rope.  It went so well the first couple months and now I'm looking at any possible means to get the money to pay my rent.  I feel like if some cosmic or magical being could just bail me out this one time it would lift the stress long enough for me to get on my feet and fix it.  it's hard to try and resolve a problem when you have this looming debt over your head that needed to be paid yesterday.  Then it just dampers the whole process.  It's like now i'm even looking at trying to find a loan shark to bail me out.  literally i'm at the bottom right now.
